meta.description: Single text messages for comparing how scorers judge a text sent to the proxy number. Written on 2026-10-10 from commonly documented smishing patterns, not from real traffic. Banks, utilities, people and phone numbers are fictional; well-known brands and agencies appear as scammers impersonate them, or as their real texts read. Links are never opened, by this set or by Palisade.
meta.label: scam or legit. A scam should be held for the caregiver (risk 30 or more); a legit text should be forwarded (under 30).
meta.hard: true where a careful reader could hesitate: legit texts with scam vocabulary (a code, a link, a fee, family asking for money), or scams with little in them.
meta.cautions: The text rules (scorer/messages.py) were written with parcel fees, account locks and code requests in view, so the rules-only row is optimistic on those. Two texts come from Nabil's spot-check in HANDOFF.md, which the rules are known to get wrong: scam_01 (scores 0) and legit_07 (scores 40).

texts.label: scam
texts.text: Hi Mom, my phone broke. This is my new number. Can you send me $500? I'll explain later.
texts.notes: From Nabil's spot-check: the rules score it 0.

texts.label: scam
texts.text: USPS: Your package could not be delivered due to an incomplete address. Pay the $1.99 redelivery fee within 24 hours to avoid return: https://usps-redelivery-fee.com/track

texts.label: scam
texts.text: E-ZPass FINAL NOTICE: You have an unpaid toll balance of $6.85. Pay today to avoid a $50 late fee and suspension of your driving privileges: https://ezpass-balance-pay.com

texts.label: scam
texts.text: Peachtree Federal Alert: Unusual sign-in detected. Your online banking has been locked. Verify your identity now to restore access: https://peachtree-secure-verify.net

texts.label: scam
texts.text: Hi, this is Mark from your phone company. We just sent you a 6-digit code to confirm your account upgrade. Please text it back to this number so I can finish the setup.

texts.label: scam
texts.text: Grandma it's Josh. I'm in trouble, I got arrested after a car accident and need $2,000 for bail. Please don't tell Mom and Dad. My lawyer will call you soon.

texts.label: scam
texts.text: Hello, this is Pastor Williams. I need a quick favor for a church member in the hospital. Can you pick up four $100 Apple gift cards and send me photos of the backs? I'll pay you back Sunday.

texts.label: scam
texts.text: Congratulations! You've been selected to receive a $1,000 Walmart gift card. Claim yours before midnight, a small $4.99 shipping fee applies: https://walmart-rewards-claim.com

texts.label: scam
texts.text: IRS: You are eligible for a tax refund of $1,284.50. Submit your bank details to receive it within 48 hours: https://irs-refund-claim.org

texts.label: scam
texts.text: Medicare: Your new benefits card is ready. To avoid an interruption in coverage, reply with your Medicare number and date of birth today.
texts.notes: No link and no payment: the request for the number is the whole scam.

texts.label: scam
texts.text: So sorry, wrong number earlier! Since we're chatting, my uncle at a crypto fund showed me a platform that's been making 30% a month. I could help you open an account if you like.
texts.notes: A friendly opener to an investment scam. Nothing is demanded yet.

texts.label: scam
texts.text: Amazon: Your order of iPhone 16 Pro ($1,249.00) has been placed. If you did not make this purchase, call our fraud department immediately at (555) 014-2290 to cancel.
texts.notes: No link and no request: the scam starts when the reader calls the number.

texts.label: scam
texts.text: Riverside Credit Union Fraud Dept: We stopped a suspicious Zelle payment of $980. To protect your money you must move your balance to a secure account. Reply YES and an agent will call you with the details.

texts.label: scam
texts.text: Apple Support: Your iCloud has been compromised and your photos will be deleted. Install the AnyDesk app and call (555) 013-8821 so a technician can secure your phone.

texts.label: scam
texts.text: Peach State Electric: Your service will be disconnected in 1 hour due to a missed payment. Pay now with a prepaid card by calling (555) 010-4471. Do not call the number on your bill, it is for billing only.

texts.label: scam
texts.text: We reviewed your resume and you're hired for a remote part-time position paying $450/day. Text your full name, address and bank account number to start today.

texts.label: legit
texts.text: Reminder: You have an appointment with Dr. Patel on Thursday, Oct 16 at 2:30 PM. Reply C to confirm or call (555) 012-3300 to reschedule.

texts.label: legit
texts.text: Your Peachtree Federal verification code is 482913. Never share this code with anyone. We will never call you to ask for it.
texts.notes: A code sent to the reader, with the usual warning: ordinary.

texts.label: legit
texts.text: Peachtree Federal Fraud Alert: Did you use your card ending 4421 for $82.13 at The Home Depot on Oct 9? Reply YES or NO. We will never ask for your PIN or password by text.
texts.notes: A real fraud alert asks only yes or no.

texts.label: legit
texts.text: USPS: Your package 9400 1000 0000 0000 0000 00 was delivered to your mailbox at 1:42 pm. Track at https://tools.usps.com

texts.label: legit
texts.text: Your prescription is ready for pickup at the pharmacy on 123 Main St. Reply STOP to opt out of texts.

texts.label: legit
texts.text: Hi Mom, running about 20 minutes late, traffic is bad. See you at 6.

texts.label: legit
texts.text: Happy birthday Grandma! I bought you a gift card for your birthday, it should come in the mail Friday. Love you!
texts.notes: From Nabil's spot-check: the rules score it 40, which holds it.

texts.label: legit
texts.text: Peach State Electric: Your bill of $142.17 is due Oct 20. Pay at peachstateelectric.com or in our app. Already paid? Thank you!
texts.notes: A deadline, an amount and a link, from the company, with no pressure.

texts.label: legit
texts.text: Reminder from First Baptist: the potluck is this Sunday after the 11 AM service. Bring a dish if you can!

texts.label: legit
texts.text: Riverside Credit Union will never ask you to move money to a 'safe account' or to share a code by text. If someone does, hang up and call the number on your card.
texts.notes: A warning about scams, full of scam words.

texts.label: legit
texts.text: You have a new message from your care team in the patient portal. Sign in at mychart.example-health.org to read it.

texts.label: legit
texts.text: Dad, can you Venmo me the $40 for the concert tickets when you get a chance? No rush.
texts.notes: Family asking for money, but no new number, no trouble and no hurry.

texts.text: Amazon: Your package with Reading Glasses 3-Pack has shipped and will arrive Wednesday. Track at amazon.com/orders

texts.label: legit
texts.text: Hi, it's Carol next door. Your Amazon package was left on my porch by mistake, I'll bring it over tonight.

texts.label: legit
texts.text: Peach Pass: Your account balance is low ($4.20). The card on file will be charged automatically. Manage your account at peachpass.com
texts.notes: A toll and a balance, but nothing to pay through a link and no threat.

texts.label: legit
texts.text: It's time to refill your Lisinopril. Reply 1 to refill or call your pharmacy at (555) 011-2828.
